proof_summary: Take \(n=51\), which satisfies \(51\not\equiv2\pmod 5\), so the relevant index is \(7044\). Since \(2^{7044}+2\equiv672\pmod{1398}\) and \(2^{672}\equiv-3\pmod{1399}\), Fermat’s theorem shows that \(1399\mid 2^{2^{7044}+2}+3\); hence its smallest prime factor is at most \(1399<1669\).
